Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is appropriate to evaluate. Because the two targets are distinct app targets (watchOS vs. iOS/widget), full consolidation into a single file may not be possible without a shared framework dependency; however, the extensions should at minimum be moved out of non-extension files (e.g., PlayerPage.swift) into dedicated extension files, and any truly shared helpers should be lifted into a common module both targets already depend on.
